extensionDescription.message: Giả mạo vị trí địa lý và múi giờ, tự động đồng bộ với VPN và chặn rò rỉ IP qua WebRTC.
extensionDescription.description: Extension description shown in the browser and store listing.

onboarding_step1_strong.description: Bolded lead-in for the first onboarding step.

onboarding_step1_text.message: Tìm kiếm một thành phố hoặc nhập tọa độ thủ công bằng các tab
onboarding_step1_text.description: Body text of the first onboarding step.

onboarding_step2_strong.description: Bolded lead-in for the second onboarding step.

onboarding_step2_text.description: Body text of the second onboarding step.

onboarding_step3_strong.description: Bolded lead-in for the third onboarding step.

onboarding_step3_text.message: Bật Bảo vệ WebRTC để tăng quyền riêng tư
onboarding_step3_text.description: Body text of the third onboarding step.

onboarding_button.description: Button that closes the onboarding overlay.

status_disabled.description: Status pill shown when location protection is off.

status_enabled.description: Status pill shown when location protection is on.

tab_main.description: Tab label for the main popup view.

tab_details.description: Tab label for the protection details view.

tab_filters.description: Tab label for the site-scoping filters view.

tab_settings.description: Hover tooltip for the settings gear button in the popup header. It opens the settings view, which holds the controls that were previously behind the 'Advanced' accordion in the Details tab. Keep short — it is a tooltip on a small icon button.

tab_settings_ariaLabel.description: Screen-reader label for the settings gear button in the popup header. Phrased as an action ('Open settings') because the button has no visible text label, unlike the tooltip which is just the destination name.

details_section_locale.description: Heading for the group of language/locale APIs listed under 'Key Overrides' in the Details tab. Shown only when a Reported Language is active.

filters_heading.description: Heading for the site-scoping filters panel.

filters_modeGroupAriaLabel.description: Accessible label for the scope-mode selector group.

filters_modeAll.description: Scope mode option: spoof on every site.

filters_modeAllowlist.description: Scope mode option: spoof only on listed sites.

filters_modeDenylist.description: Scope mode option: spoof on every site except listed ones.

filters_modeAllDesc.message: Giả mạo áp dụng cho mọi trang web.
filters_modeAllDesc.description: Description shown under the selector when 'All' mode is active.

filters_modeAllowlistDesc.message: Giả mạo chỉ áp dụng cho các trang web trong danh sách.
filters_modeAllowlistDesc.description: Description shown under the selector when 'Allowlist' mode is active.

filters_modeDenylistDesc.message: Giả mạo áp dụng cho mọi trang web trừ các trang trong danh sách.
filters_modeDenylistDesc.description: Description shown under the selector when 'Denylist' mode is active.

filters_addPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text in the add-site input.

filters_addButton.description: Button that adds the typed domain to the active list.

filters_invalidDomain.description: Inline message shown when the typed pattern is invalid.

filters_emptyList.description: Indicator shown when the active site list is empty.

filters_notSaved.description: Inline message shown when a scope change could not be saved.

filters_loadError.description: Inline message shown when the popup cannot load settings.

filters_removeAriaLabel.description: Accessible label prefix on a site's remove button.

filters_addCurrentButton.description: Button that adds the active tab's site to the active list.

filters_currentPageRestricted.description: Inline message shown when the current page is a restricted URL that cannot be added.

filters_currentPageInvalid.message: Không thể thêm trang web này
filters_currentPageInvalid.description: Inline message shown when the current tab's hostname cannot be added to a list.

filters_allowedSites.description: Header above the list of allowlisted sites.

filters_blockedSites.description: Header above the list of denylisted sites.

filters_syntaxTitle.message: Tôi có thể dùng những mẫu nào?
filters_syntaxTitle.description: Summary label for the collapsible supported-pattern-syntax reference in the Filters tab.

filters_syntaxDomain.message: Trang web và tất cả tên miền phụ của nó
filters_syntaxDomain.description: Explains the bare-domain pattern form (e.g. example.com) in the syntax reference.

filters_syntaxSubdomains.message: Chỉ tên miền phụ, không bao gồm chính example.com
filters_syntaxSubdomains.description: Explains the wildcard-subdomain pattern form (e.g. *.example.com), which excludes the apex, in the syntax reference.

filters_syntaxTld.message: Bất kỳ trang web nào kết thúc bằng .ru
filters_syntaxTld.description: Explains the wildcard-TLD pattern form (e.g. *.ru) in the syntax reference.

filters_syntaxPort.message: Một máy chủ trên một cổng cụ thể
filters_syntaxPort.description: Explains the host:port pattern form (e.g. localhost:3000) in the syntax reference.

filters_syntaxPath.message: Một đường dẫn và mọi thứ bên dưới nó
filters_syntaxPath.description: Explains the path pattern form (e.g. site.com/app/*) in the syntax reference.

filters_syntaxIdn.message: Tên miền quốc tế cũng hoạt động
filters_syntaxIdn.description: Explains that internationalized (non-ASCII) domain names are supported, in the syntax reference.

filters_syntaxNotes.message: Chỉ * là ký tự đại diện — không hỗ trợ biểu thức chính quy.
filters_syntaxNotes.description: The short capability note at the bottom of the syntax reference.

filters_syntaxReference.description: Link at the bottom of the syntax reference that opens the full Site Filters documentation on GitHub.

toggle_locationProtection.description: Label for the toggle that enables location spoofing.

toggle_webrtcProtection.description: Label for the toggle that enables WebRTC IP leak protection.

toggle_preserveGeoPrompt.description: Label for the toggle that makes GeoSpoof show the browser's native geolocation permission prompt (and only substitute the spoofed location after the user allows) instead of silently auto-granting it to every site.

preserveGeoPrompt_infoAriaLabel.message: Thông tin thêm về Giữ lời nhắc vị trí
preserveGeoPrompt_infoAriaLabel.description: Accessible label on the Preserve location prompts info icon.

preserveGeoPrompt_tooltip.message: Chỉ áp dụng cho các trang mà GeoSpoof đang giả mạo (theo danh sách cho phép/chặn của bạn). Khi bật, các trang đó hiển thị lời nhắc xin quyền vị trí thông thường của trình duyệt và chỉ nhận vị trí giả mạo nếu bạn cho phép. Khi tắt, chúng tự động nhận mà không cần lời nhắc.
preserveGeoPrompt_tooltip.description: Tooltip explaining the Preserve location prompts toggle: native permission prompt with spoofed coordinates vs. silent auto-grant. Notes that it only affects sites in spoofing scope (allow/deny list).

heading_location.description: Section heading above the spoofed location display.

heading_protection.description: Section heading above the protection toggles in the Main tab.

heading_mode.description: Section heading above the scope-mode selector in the Filters tab.

location_none.description: Shown when no spoofed location has been configured.

location_custom.description: Shown above a manually entered (non-search) location.

location_clearTitle.description: Tooltip title on the clear-location button.

location_clearAriaLabel.description: Accessible label on the clear-location button.

toggle_syncWithVpn.description: Label for the toggle that syncs location to the user's public IP.

vpnSync_infoAriaLabel.message: Thêm thông tin về Đồng bộ với VPN
vpnSync_infoAriaLabel.description: Accessible label on the VPN sync info icon.

vpnSync_tooltip.message: Tính năng này đồng bộ vị trí giả mạo của bạn với IP công khai hiện tại. Nó tự động cập nhật vài giây sau khi VPN của bạn đổi máy chủ — hoặc dùng Đồng bộ lại để cập nhật ngay.
vpnSync_tooltip.description: Tooltip explaining that VPN sync auto-updates when the VPN changes servers, with a manual Re-sync option.

vpnSync_syncNow.description: Button that performs an initial VPN sync.

vpnSync_resync.description: Button that performs a follow-up VPN sync.

vpnSync_detectedIp.description: Shown after a successful VPN sync. $IP$ is the detected public IP address.

vpnSync_networkError.message: Đã xảy ra lỗi mạng. Vui lòng thử lại.
vpnSync_networkError.description: Error toast shown when the VPN sync network call fails.

inputTab_searchCity.description: Tab label for the city-search input mode.

inputTab_enterCoords.description: Tab label for the manual-coordinates input mode.

search_placeholder.description: Placeholder text in the city search input.

search_searching.description: Status shown while a city search is in flight.

search_noResults.message: Không tìm thấy vị trí nào
search_noResults.description: Status shown when a city search returns no matches.

search_failed.message: Tìm kiếm thất bại. Vui lòng thử lại.
search_failed.description: Error toast shown when a city search request fails.

search_settingLocation.description: Status shown while a chosen location is being applied.

search_setLocationFailed.message: Không thể đặt vị trí. Vui lòng thử lại.
search_setLocationFailed.description: Error toast shown when applying a chosen location fails.

coords_latPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text in the latitude input.

coords_lonPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text in the longitude input.

coords_setButton.description: Button that applies the manually entered coordinates.

coords_pasteHint.message: Mẹo: dán một cặp tọa độ hoặc một geohash
coords_pasteHint.description: Discovery hint under the coordinate inputs telling the user they can paste a lat/lon pair, DMS, or a geohash instead of typing.

coords_pasteFailed.message: Không đọc được tọa độ — hãy thử một cặp tọa độ hoặc một geohash
coords_pasteFailed.description: Inline error shown under the coordinate inputs when a pasted string looked like a coordinate but could not be parsed.

coords_invalidLat.message: Vĩ độ không hợp lệ. Phải nằm trong khoảng -90 đến 90.
coords_invalidLat.description: Validation error shown when latitude is out of range.

coords_invalidLon.message: Kinh độ không hợp lệ. Phải nằm trong khoảng -180 đến 180.
coords_invalidLon.description: Validation error shown when longitude is out of range.

warning_noLocationSet.message: ⚠️ Đã bật bảo vệ nhưng chưa đặt vị trí
warning_noLocationSet.description: Warning shown when protection is on but no location is configured.

warning_refreshPage.message: ⚠️ Làm mới trang này để áp dụng bảo vệ
warning_refreshPage.description: Warning shown when the active page must be reloaded for protection to apply.

notice_restrictedPage.message: ℹ️ Không thể chạy tiện ích mở rộng trên trang này
notice_restrictedPage.description: Notice shown on browser-internal pages where extensions cannot run.

testLinks_verify.description: Footer link to the hosted verification page that checks the user's protection.

support_needHelp.description: Footer link prompting the user to open the support page.

support_review.description: Footer link that opens a short modal asking the user to leave a store review.

iosPromo_text.message: Đổi GPS thật của iPhone bằng GeoSpoof
iosPromo_text.description: Footer cross-link to the GeoSpoof app on the App Store. Leads with what the app does - move the iPhone's real, system-level GPS - rather than with the product name, because the name alone does not say what you get. Names no desktop platform on purpose: the Mac and Windows companions are discovered on the store page, and leaving them out keeps the label on one line at the popup's 350px width.

vpnPromo_text.description: Footer cross-link inviting the user to pair GeoSpoof with Proton VPN (a disclosed affiliate recommendation); shown on non-Apple operating systems (Windows/Linux/Android/ChromeOS) in place of the Apple App Store link. Points at the on-site /vpn recommendation page.

vpnPromo_ariaLabel.message: Kết hợp với Proton VPN (quảng cáo)
vpnPromo_ariaLabel.description: Accessible label for the footer Proton VPN affiliate cross-link (the visible text sits next to a shield glyph).

vpnPromo_tag.description: Small inline marker disclosing that the adjacent Proton VPN link is an affiliate link.

review_modal_title.description: Heading of the modal that asks the user to leave a review.

review_modal_body1.message: GeoSpoof được xây dựng cẩn thận — không theo dõi, không tài khoản. Tôi xây dựng và duy trì nó bằng thời gian của riêng mình.
review_modal_body1.description: First paragraph of the review-request modal (desktop builds).

review_modal_body1_ios.message: GeoSpoof được xây dựng bằng tâm huyết — không theo dõi, không tài khoản. Tôi dành thời gian riêng để giữ vị trí của bạn ở chế độ riêng tư.
review_modal_body1_ios.description: First paragraph of the review-request modal on iOS, where the app is freemium so it does not claim to be free.

review_modal_body2.message: Một đánh giá nhanh là cách tốt nhất để ủng hộ nó. Chỉ mất một phút và giúp nhiều người tìm thấy GeoSpoof hơn. Cảm ơn bạn rất nhiều!
review_modal_body2.description: Second paragraph of the review-request modal.

review_modal_cta.description: Primary button in the review modal that opens the store review page.

review_modal_dismiss.description: Secondary button that dismisses the review modal.

webrtc_configFailed.message: Không thể cấu hình bảo vệ WebRTC. Hãy kiểm tra quyền của tiện ích mở rộng.
webrtc_configFailed.description: Error toast shown when WebRTC protection cannot be configured.

details_spoofedLocation.description: Section title for the spoofed-location details.

details_spoofedTimezone.description: Section title for the spoofed-timezone details.

details_webrtcProtection.description: Section title for the WebRTC protection details.

details_overriddenApis.description: Section title for the list of overridden browser APIs.

details_notConfigured.description: Placeholder shown when a detail field has no value.

details_none.description: Shown when a detail field has no items.

details_noneDisabled.description: Shown when a detail field is empty because protection is off.

details_latitudeLabel.description: Label for the latitude row in the location details.

details_longitudeLabel.description: Label for the longitude row in the location details.

details_accuracyLabel.description: Label for the accuracy row in the location details.

details_locationLabel.description: Label for the location-name row in the location details.

details_identifierLabel.description: Label for the timezone-identifier row in the timezone details.

details_offsetLabel.description: Label for the UTC-offset row in the timezone details.

details_dstOffsetLabel.description: Label for the DST-offset row in the timezone details.

details_dstOffsetMinutes.description: Formatted DST offset in minutes. $MINUTES$ is the integer minute count.

details_fallbackNote.description: Inline note shown when timezone data is estimated rather than authoritative.

details_webrtcActiveStatus.description: Status label shown in the WebRTC details when protection is active.

details_webrtcInactiveStatus.description: Status label shown in the WebRTC details when protection is inactive.

details_webrtcInactiveNote.message: WebRTC có thể làm rò rỉ địa chỉ IP thật của bạn ngay cả khi đang dùng VPN.
details_webrtcInactiveNote.description: Caption shown under the WebRTC status when protection is inactive.

details_section_geolocation.description: Header for the geolocation overrides section.

details_section_timezone.description: Header for the timezone overrides section.

details_section_webrtc.description: Header for the WebRTC overrides section.

details_section_dateTime.description: Header for the date/time overrides section.

details_section_temporal.description: Header for the Temporal API overrides section.

details_section_xslt.description: Header for the XSLT/EXSLT overrides section.

details_section_workers.description: Header for the worker timezone-propagation overrides section.

details_section_antiFingerprinting.message: Chống lấy vân tay và cấu trúc
details_section_antiFingerprinting.description: Header for the anti-fingerprinting and structural overrides section.

details_keyOverrides.description: Title of the summary line above the grouped list of overridden APIs.

advanced_button.description: Button that opens the advanced-settings drawer.

advanced_earlyTz.message: Bảo vệ múi giờ tức thì
advanced_earlyTz.description: Label for the Firefox-only toggle that grants the userScripts permission to spoof synchronous timezone surfaces from the very first script on a page.

earlyTz_infoAriaLabel.message: Thêm thông tin về Bảo vệ múi giờ tức thì
earlyTz_infoAriaLabel.description: Accessible label on the Instant timezone protection info icon.

earlyTz_tooltip.message: Chỉ dành cho Firefox. Bật tính năng này sẽ yêu cầu quyền tùy chọn “userScripts” để GeoSpoof có thể chạy ngay từ đầu mỗi lần tải trang, khắc phục khoảng trống ngắn mà một trang có thể đọc múi giờ thật của bạn trước khi bảo vệ kích hoạt. Tắt nó để thu hồi quyền.
earlyTz_tooltip.description: Tooltip explaining the Firefox-only Instant timezone protection toggle and the userScripts permission it requests.

advanced_debuggerMode.description: Label for the Chrome-only toggle that spoofs the timezone deeper in the browser (via the chrome.debugger API / Chrome DevTools Protocol) so it also covers background workers and applies before a page loads.

debuggerMode_infoAriaLabel.message: Thêm thông tin về Giả mạo cấp engine
debuggerMode_infoAriaLabel.description: Accessible label on the Engine-level Spoofing info icon.

debuggerMode_tooltip.message: Chỉ dành cho Chrome. Giả mạo múi giờ sâu hơn trong trình duyệt để cũng bao phủ các worker nền và có hiệu lực trước khi trang tải. Khi bật, Chrome hiển thị thanh “GeoSpoof started debugging this browser” — đó là điều bình thường. Hãy tắt nó để dùng bảo vệ tiêu chuẩn.
debuggerMode_tooltip.description: Tooltip explaining the Chrome-only Engine-level Spoofing toggle and the debugging notification bar it causes.

debuggerBannerHelp_text.message: Khi bật, Chrome hiển thị thanh “GeoSpoof started debugging this browser”. Để ẩn nó, hãy khởi động Chrome với cờ này:
debuggerBannerHelp_text.description: Intro text of the dismissible note shown when Engine-level Spoofing is enabled, explaining how to hide Chrome's debugging notification bar.

debuggerBannerHelp_link.description: Link to the GeoSpoof help page explaining how to hide Chrome's debugging notification bar.

debuggerBannerHelp_closeAria.description: Accessible label for the button that dismisses the debugging-bar help note.

advanced_verbosity_warn.description: Verbosity level: error and warning logs.

advanced_verbosity_debug.description: Verbosity level: info and debug logs.

advanced_verbosity_trace.description: Verbosity level: full trace including per-call logs.

advanced_theme.description: Label for the popup theme selector.

advanced_theme_system.description: Theme option that follows the OS appearance.

advanced_theme_light.description: Theme option that forces the light popup theme.

advanced_theme_dark.description: Theme option that forces the dark popup theme.

advanced_accuracy.description: Label for the accuracy selector that controls how the spoofed GeolocationCoordinates.accuracy value is produced.

advanced_accuracy_realistic.description: Accuracy option that picks a device-appropriate value automatically (auto mode).

advanced_accuracy_custom.description: Accuracy option that reveals a numeric input for an exact meter value (fixed mode).

advanced_accuracy_customMeters.description: Label for the numeric input shown when the Custom accuracy option is selected.

advanced_accuracy_customHint.message: Nhập một giá trị từ 1 đến 10000 mét
advanced_accuracy_customHint.description: Inline hint shown when the custom accuracy value is out of the allowed range.

advanced_accuracy_customSet.description: Button that commits the typed custom accuracy value (fixed mode). The custom value is applied only when this button is clicked or Enter is pressed.

advanced_accuracy_customEdit.description: Button that reopens the custom accuracy editor from the compact display showing the committed value.

advanced_precision.description: Label for the precision selector that controls whether the reported location is the exact point or an approximate point within a radius.

advanced_precision_exact.description: Precision option that reports the exact chosen coordinates (default).

advanced_precision_street.description: Precision option that reports an approximate point within about half a kilometer of the chosen location.

advanced_precision_neighborhood.description: Precision option that reports an approximate point within about two kilometers of the chosen location.

advanced_precision_city.description: Precision option that reports an approximate point within about ten kilometers of the chosen location.

advanced_precision_hint.message: “Gần đúng” báo một điểm ngẫu nhiên gần vị trí của bạn thay vì đúng điểm đó.
advanced_precision_hint.description: Explanatory note under the precision dropdown describing what the approximate options do.

advanced_precision_proNote.message: 🔒 Vị trí gần đúng là tính năng của GeoSpoof Pro. Hãy nâng cấp trong ứng dụng GeoSpoof để làm mờ vị trí chính xác của bạn.
advanced_precision_proNote.description: Shown for non-Pro iOS users when the precision control is disabled, explaining that approximate location is a Pro feature.

advanced_precisionCadence.description: Label for the dropdown setting how often Approximate location picks a new random point in the same radius.

advanced_precisionCadence_never.description: Default. Keep the same point until the location or precision changes.

advanced_precisionCadence_session.description: A new point each time the browser starts.

advanced_precisionCadence_hour.description: A new point about once an hour. Open pages move too.

advanced_precisionCadence_day.description: A new point about once a day. Open pages move too.

advanced_coffee.message: ☕ Mời tôi một ly cà phê
advanced_coffee.description: Footer link inviting the user to buy the maintainer a coffee.

advanced_language.description: Label for the popup UI language selector in Advanced settings.

advanced_language_system.description: Language selector option that follows the browser's UI language instead of a fixed choice.

advanced_locale.description: Label for the control that sets the language websites see (navigator.language, Intl formats, and the Accept-Language header). Deliberately distinct from 'Language', which sets GeoSpoof's own popup language.

advanced_locale_off.description: Reported Language option that leaves the browser's real language untouched (the default).

advanced_locale_match.description: Reported Language option that derives the language automatically from the spoofed location.

advanced_locale_custom.description: Reported Language option that reveals a text input for picking a specific language tag.

advanced_locale_customTag.description: Accessible label for the text input where a BCP47 language tag such as fr-FR is entered.

advanced_locale_customSet.description: Button that commits the typed language tag. The value is applied only when this button is clicked or Enter is pressed.

advanced_locale_customEdit.description: Button that reopens the language editor from the compact display showing the committed tag.

advanced_locale_customHint.message: Nhập thẻ ngôn ngữ mà trình duyệt của bạn hỗ trợ, ví dụ fr-FR hoặc ja
advanced_locale_customHint.description: Inline hint shown when the entered language tag is malformed or unsupported by the browser, so it was not applied.

advanced_locale_warning.message: ⚠️ Nhiều trang web sẽ chuyển sang ngôn ngữ này, và nó được gửi kèm mọi yêu cầu.
advanced_locale_warning.description: Caution shown while a reported language is active, explaining that sites will visibly change language and that the choice is also sent as an HTTP header.

advanced_locale_hint.message: Đặt ngôn ngữ mà các trang web thấy — navigator.language, định dạng ngày và số, và tiêu đề Accept-Language.
advanced_locale_hint.description: Explanatory note under the Reported Language control describing which signals it changes.

advanced_locale_proNote.message: 🔒 Ngôn ngữ được báo là tính năng của GeoSpoof Pro. Hãy nâng cấp trong ứng dụng GeoSpoof để đổi ngôn ngữ mà các trang web thấy.
advanced_locale_proNote.description: Shown for non-Pro users when the Reported Language control is disabled, explaining that it is a Pro feature.

siteLocation_statusSite.description: Compact line on the Main tab, shown only when a site location applies to the current tab. $SITE$ is the site's host name without a leading www., $PLACE$ the site location's name.

siteLocation_useMain.description: Text button on the Main-tab site location line that stops using the site location for the current site, so it uses the main (global) location again. 'Main location' is the glossary term for the global location.

siteLocation_hintAllowlist.message: Bộ lọc không giả mạo trang này. Thêm vào danh sách cho phép?
siteLocation_hintAllowlist.description: Hint in the site location editor in allowlist mode when the current site isn't on the allowlist, so the site location wouldn't apply there.

siteLocation_addToAllowlist.message: Thêm vào danh sách cho phép
siteLocation_addToAllowlist.description: One-tap button in the site location editor that adds the current site to the Filters allowlist.

siteLocation_hintDenylist.message: Bộ lọc không giả mạo trang này vì nó nằm trong danh sách chặn của bạn.
siteLocation_hintDenylist.description: Hint in the site location editor in denylist mode when the current site is blocked by the denylist, so the site location wouldn't apply there.

siteLocation_hintVpn.message: Các trang web vẫn thấy địa chỉ IP của VPN. Dùng vị trí khác ở đây có thể trông không nhất quán.
siteLocation_hintVpn.description: Hint shown with Sync with VPN on, in the site location editor and under the Main-tab site location line, explaining that a site location doesn't change the IP address sites see.

siteLocation_reloadHint.message: Tải lại các trang của trang web này để áp dụng thay đổi ở mọi nơi.
siteLocation_reloadHint.description: Hint shown right after a site location change made from the popup, because already-open pages keep their old values until reloaded.

siteLocation_sitesLabel.description: Label of the site location editor's text field listing the sites the location applies to.

siteLocation_sitesHint.message: Phân tách các trang bằng dấu phẩy, ví dụ: chatgpt.com, openai.com
siteLocation_sitesHint.description: Help text under the Sites field. Keep the example domains unchanged.

siteLocation_searchLabel.description: Label of the site location editor's location search field.

siteLocation_favoriteLabel.message: Hoặc chọn một mục yêu thích
siteLocation_favoriteLabel.description: Label of the site location editor's favorites dropdown.

siteLocation_favoriteNone.description: Placeholder option in the site location editor's favorites dropdown.

siteLocation_chosenNone.description: Shown in the site location editor before a location has been picked.

siteLocation_explain.message: Các trang trên $SITES$, cùng mọi thứ được nhúng trong đó, sẽ thấy $PLACE$. Các trang khác giữ vị trí chính của bạn.
siteLocation_explain.description: Plain-language summary in the site location editor. $SITES$ is the comma-separated site list, $PLACE$ the chosen location.

siteLocation_save.description: Button that saves the site location in the editor.

siteLocation_cancel.description: Button that closes the site location editor without saving.

siteLocation_errorPattern.message: Hãy dùng trang như example.com, không có đường dẫn và không chỉ là *.
siteLocation_errorPattern.description: Error when a site in the Sites field isn't a valid site location pattern (paths and a bare * aren't allowed).

siteLocation_errorInUse.description: Error when a site already belongs to another entry in Per-site locations. $SITE$ is the site, $PLACE$ the name of the location it already uses.

siteLocation_editOwner.description: Button next to the siteLocation_errorInUse error that opens the other entry for editing.

siteLocation_errorCapacity.message: Bạn có thể có tối đa $MAX$ vị trí ở đây. Hãy xóa một mục trước.
siteLocation_errorCapacity.description: Error when Per-site locations already holds the maximum number of entries. $MAX$ is the limit. 'here' means this list; avoid wording that reads as a limit per site.

siteLocation_errorTooManySites.message: Một vị trí có thể áp dụng cho tối đa $MAX$ trang.
siteLocation_errorTooManySites.description: Error when too many sites are listed for one location in Per-site locations. $MAX$ is the limit.

siteLocation_errorTimezone.message: Không tra được múi giờ của địa điểm này. Hãy kiểm tra kết nối và thử lại.
siteLocation_errorTimezone.description: Error when the time zone of the chosen place couldn't be determined, so the site location wasn't saved.

siteLocation_errorNoLocation.description: Error when saving a site location before picking a location.

siteLocation_sectionTitle.description: Label of the collapsed Per-site locations disclosure at the bottom of the Filters tab. 'Per-site locations' is the feature's glossary name: each site can have its own location. Keep it short, with no 'optional'.

siteLocation_sectionDesc.message: Dùng vị trí khác trên các trang cụ thể.
siteLocation_sectionDesc.description: One short line under the Per-site locations disclosure label on the Filters tab.

siteLocation_add.message: Đặt vị trí cho một trang
siteLocation_add.description: Button inside the Per-site locations disclosure on the Filters tab that opens the editor for a new entry. Worded so it can't be read as adding a filter.

siteLocation_edit.description: Button on a site location row on the Filters tab, and on the Main-tab site location line, that opens the site location for editing.

siteLocation_editAriaLabel.description: Accessible label prefix on the edit button of an entry in Per-site locations; the location's name follows (e.g. 'Edit location Dublin'), as with filters_removeAriaLabel.

siteLocation_removeAriaLabel.description: Accessible label prefix on the remove button of an entry in Per-site locations; the location's name follows (e.g. 'Remove location Dublin'), as with filters_removeAriaLabel.

siteLocation_listAriaLabel.description: Accessible label of the Per-site locations list on the Filters tab. Same text as siteLocation_sectionTitle.

siteLocation_proNote.message: 🔒 Vị trí theo trang là tính năng của GeoSpoof Pro. Hãy nâng cấp trong ứng dụng GeoSpoof để đặt vị trí riêng cho các trang web.
siteLocation_proNote.description: Shown inside the Per-site locations disclosure on the Filters tab for non-Pro users, whose controls there are disabled, explaining that it is a Pro feature.

details_siteLocation.description: Details tab heading for the location Per-site locations applies to the current tab; the value names the place, the site, and the time zone. Shown only when one applies.

badge_titleSiteLocation.description: Toolbar button tooltip when a site location applies to the current tab. $PLACE$ is the site location's name, $SITE$ the host name.
